hero.copy: Oriel is an architecture and interiors studio in Lisbon and Copenhagen, designing calm, material-led homes, workplaces and small hotels for people who notice the details.

image.alt: Angular white-clad building with a glazed corner, set against a pale sky

hero.caption: Casa do Farol, Aveiro — 2023

image.alt: A low modern house at dusk, its glazed living room glowing warmly above a still pool

manifesto.text: We believe good architecture is quiet. It listens before it speaks, frames what is already there, and leaves room for the lives that will slowly fill it.
manifesto.note: For fourteen years we have worked across private homes, workplaces and small hotels — always with one team, from the first sketch to the final handover.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: Every brief begins on site. We spend time with you and the place — the light at different hours, the way you move, what you want to keep — before we draw anything.

image.alt: An architect sketching plans by hand at a timber desk

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Sketches become models, models become drawings. We test proportion, material and daylight until each room feels inevitable rather than designed.

image.alt: Sunlit living room with leather sofas, a gallery wall and large windows

steps.title: Build
steps.text: We stay on site until handover, working with a small circle of trusted makers so that the finished building is as considered as the first idea.

image.alt: Site team in hard hats on a concrete deck overlooking reinforcement being laid

stats.label: Of clients return for a second project

services.title: Architecture
services.text: New homes, careful extensions and the restoration of existing buildings — designed from the landscape inwards, with daylight and material as our first tools.

services.title: Interior design
services.text: Complete interiors for homes, hotels and workplaces. We design the shell and everything inside it, so the building and its rooms speak with one voice.

services.title: Furniture & objects
services.text: Bespoke joinery, lighting and small editions of furniture, made with independent workshops in Portugal and Denmark.

services.title: Planning & delivery
services.text: Feasibility studies, permits, tendering and site supervision. One team takes responsibility from the first conversation to the keys.

quote.text: They listened for months before drawing a single line. Four years on, the house still feels as if it was always meant to be there.
quote.name: Ingrid Holm
